fields.description: Who serves this model. Prefixes the model id (frappe/qwen3.5-4b) — set at creation, part of the name from then on. A provider with a Base URL is a third-party vendor: the model routes straight there and no engine is started for it.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: The client-facing id, without its provider prefix — what a client sends as `model`. Lowercased on save, with spaces and underscores as dashes ('Qwen3.5 Coder' → qwen3.5-coder). Names the doc, so it is set once at creation.
fields.label: Model ID

fields.description: What the upstream is asked for, when that is not the id above — a vendor's dated snapshot (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929), or the name a container image advertises for itself. Blank sends the id the caller used, which is what our own engines are started under.
fields.label: Upstream Model ID

fields.description: Which OpenAI surfaces this model answers on. The gateway refuses the rest itself, before dialling anything: an embedding model asked for chat is a local 404, not a round trip. embedding is a pooling model served at /v1/embeddings; text also sets --language-model-only on an engine we run.
fields.label: Modality

fields.description: Mirrored from the provider so the form knows whether this model is one we host or one we dial.
fields.label: Provider Base URL

fields.description: Auto: this model has a live route (an Active Model Replica or a Running Pod). Not an access gate — access is granted per user, via Grove User Group or Grove User.
fields.label: Published

fields.description: How we serve this model ourselves — the repo, the weights, and the vllm role vars (playbooks/inference_server). Blank = flag omitted / role default. Absent for a model a provider serves: there is no engine to launch.
fields.label: Launch Profile

fields.description: → vllm serve ; the name is the --served-model-name. A GGUF repo ships many quantizations — name one with repo:QUANT (unsloth/Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF:Q4_K_M) so only that file is pulled, and add --tokenizer <base repo> to Extra Serve Args on the deployment, since converting a GGUF's own tokenizer is slow and unreliable. Single-file quantizations only; a split one has to be merged first.
fields.label: HF Repo

fields.description: S3 mirror of the safetensors weights. When set, engines stream them straight from S3 to the GPU (runai streamer) instead of downloading from HF — fill it with Mirror Weights To S3, or clear it to fall back to HF.
fields.label: Weights S3 URI

fields.description: From the repo's config.json. Used to reject a GPU split the model can't run before it reaches the box. Blank = that check is skipped.
fields.label: Architecture

fields.description: num_attention_heads. vLLM shards heads across the tensor-parallel group, so this must divide evenly by tensor-parallel size (e.g. 64 heads cannot run on 6 GPUs).
fields.label: Attention Heads

fields.description: torch_dtype from the repo's config.json — what vLLM serves these weights in unless a placement overrides it. bfloat16 needs a card of compute capability 8.0 or better and hard-raises below it, so a placement onto an older card is rejected here rather than minutes into a play. Blank = that check is skipped.
fields.label: Torch Dtype

fields.description: num_hidden_layers. Informational — vLLM splits these across the pipeline-parallel group and spreads any remainder, so the count need not divide evenly.
fields.label: Hidden Layers

fields.description: Size of the weights, summed per dtype from the repo's safetensors index. A placement whose GPUs can't hold this much is rejected — note it counts weights only, so the KV cache and activations need headroom on top.
fields.label: Weights (GB)

fields.description: If set, the reasoning parser below is applied.
fields.label: Reasoning Model

fields.description: → --reasoning-parser (only when Reasoning Model is checked). e.g. qwen3.
fields.label: Reasoning Parser
